notes: Patient history now loads as its own shared file

sort.label: Smart Sort
notes: Removes an SL modifier when the patient is 18 or older (keeps it under 18)

coding.label: Coding
notes: Vaccine admin: 90460/90461 for ages 0–18, 90471/90472 from 19 (same ages as SL). Added 90694 (adjuvanted flu): 1 component, G0008 for Medicare
Dragging opens a gap and the other rows slide aside; ↑ ↓ slide the rows too. The ↑ ↓ × buttons are now clearly visible
Manual order: drag codes (or use ↑ ↓) in 'After changes'; applied on Add to EMR. 'Reset order' goes back to ECW Pilot's order
Manual remove: × on any code in 'After changes' removes it on Add to EMR and stops ECW Pilot proposing it again for this visit; ↺ puts it back
Chief complaint is read from eCW's data for the OPEN visit (getEncounterDetails) — never from page text
Vitals (BP, BMI, BMI %) are read from eCW's Vitals data for the OPEN visit only — never from page text; while they load, no changes are proposed

Age = age on the VISIT day, read only from eCW's Angular data (patient DOB + the open visit's date) — never page text or today's date; if it can't be read, no changes are proposed (DOB is cross-checked between the patient record and the visit record)
UHC: no G-codes on the claim — ECW Pilot doesn't add them and removes any already on the chart (except G0101 / G0102 / G0103)
G0444 / G0442 on any visit (not only preventive), once per insurance per calendar year, not for Medicare / Medicaid / UHC
Depression: G0444 (3725F when G0444 can't be billed) + G8510 / G8431 (UHC: 3725F alone)
Alcohol: positive → G0442 (3016F when G0442 can't be billed); negative → 3016F (screening performed) + G9622 (negative) for every insurance — UHC: 3016F only

link.label: Link
notes: SL modifier only for patients under 18 (age on the visit day)
Age on the VISIT day from eCW's Angular data only; DOB cross-checked between patient and visit records
